title: Chapter 8 Jungle Ambush
content:
Chapter 8 Jungle Ambush

Just when Wu Qing got the biological colonization suit and was having a great time, the gate of the greenskin camp opened wide, and the greenskin army, which had been well-fed and well-rested, began to move out.

Through the dog's vision, Wu Qing found that these greenskins did not go to find the opponents they fought yesterday, but came to the forest, and seemed to want to cause trouble for him.

"Are you going to fight me?"

"It just so happens that I am also interested in you."

"I will play with you for a while."

Wu Qing would not refuse the resources that were offered to him, and he began to deploy his troops.

He used the dog's ability to burrow into the ground and lurked, and let several dogs sneak to the vicinity of the greenskin camp, and found out the number of this greenskin army, which was about 800 to 1,000, and would not exceed 1,000.

Even if there were only 800 people, with the current strength of the Zerg, the chances of winning a head-on confrontation with them outside the Zerg territory were not high.

However, the commander of the greenskins has not yet realized the huge threat of the Zerg, and has only sent out a vanguard of about 300 people.

According to common sense, such an arrangement is not wrong, but unfortunately they are facing an unusual Zerg.

Fighting in the forest, Wu Qing has the advantage of home field. With the existing troops, fighting to support the war, there is a great hope to wipe out the greenskin army today.

More than 100 puppies in the territory are divided into three teams, each with 10 hydralisks, and they go to advantageous positions in the forest to burrow and lurk.

The 100 puppies scattered outside for reconnaissance continue to scout, and when necessary, they can make some noise to distract the attention of the greenskins.

Wu Qing is arranging troops, and the vanguard of the greenskins, led by ten lizard knights, came to the front of the forest.

The greenskins learned the lesson of yesterday and dared not to disperse into the forest again. Instead, every two knights led a team of people and horses, divided into five teams to enter the forest.

It seemed that the last battle yesterday exposed the location of the valley where the Zerg territory was located. The five teams had very clear goals and searched the valley where the Zerg territory was located from different positions.

The remaining troops in the greenskin camp had also reorganized their teams and were ready to support the battle in the forest at any time.

The puppies scattered in the forest began to appear. They showed up from time to time, or raided the greenskin team, and ran away at a touch, making noise everywhere.

The greenskins fought back at first, but later they were too lazy to pay attention.

Seeing the response of the greenskins, Wu Qing adjusted his strategy and gathered the three separated teams into an ambush.

More than 100 puppies and 30 hydralisks occupied the advantageous terrain and lurked underground.

A team of about 60 greenskins slowly approached the ambush circle. At this time, there were still a few puppies around their team constantly harassing them to reduce their vigilance.

When all the greenskins walked into the ambush circle, a large group of Zergs came out from underground. Facing this ambush, they didn't even have time to react.

The absolute advantage of the number of puppies, plus the terrifying long-range attacks of 30 hydralisks in advantageous positions, just one wave of attacks, nearly 60 greenskins were lying down.

The movement here attracted the attention of other greenskins, and the other four greenskin teams quickly rushed here.

Wu Qing clearly judged the advance route of each greenskin team through the vision of many puppies distributed in the forest.

The puppies and hydralisks, who had fought a beautiful ambush, silently moved towards the next selected ambush site.

The two greenskin teams closest to the ambush battle site arrived quickly. What appeared in front of them was a ground full of weapons and sundries, and all the greenskins disappeared.

"Spirit God!"

Such a scene made the greenskins a little panic.

When the third team of greenskins arrived at the scene, the roar and screams of the greenskins were heard not far away.

"No! We've been tricked!"

"Everyone gather together and hold on, send a distress signal to the priest!"

The leading greenskin knight reacted and ordered immediately.

"Swoosh!"

A dazzling white light rose from the forest, indicating the location of the greenskin army outside the forest.

Nearly two hundred greenskins gathered together, relying on the terrain environment, to form a defensive position and stationed on the spot.

Through the puppy's vision, Wu Qing saw the greenskin army in the camp coming out in full force, one of the huge lizards was particularly conspicuous, with a greenskin wearing a white robe standing on its back.

The eight mother nests in the Zerg territory began to send troops with all their strength. If there were gas resources, they would send out hydralisks, and if there was not enough gas, they would send out puppies.

At this time, the number of hosts had reached 30, and the population limit was enough to send troops with all their strength.

After a while, another team of greenskins who were ambushed were all defeated, and another batch of resources came in.

The ambush troops with almost no losses, plus the Zerglings gathered from all over the forest, and the continuous reinforcements from the mother nest in the rear, the entire Zerg army quickly grew stronger.

Nearly 200 Zerglings, 40 Hydralisks.

"Attack!"

The Zerg fights, except for attacking, and still attacking.

The reinforcements of the Greenskins are coming, and the remaining three teams are gathered together to garrison. Now there is no other tactic to choose except to play a time difference and attack from the front.

However, now with 40 Hydralisks, the Zerglings don't need to rush up and fight hard in the first wave, which can greatly reduce their damage.

200 Zerglings swarmed in, staring at the periphery of the Greenskins' defense line.

40 Hydralisks calmly found their attack positions and began to attack.

The terrifying spike attack whistled and hit the greenskins, leaving them with skin and flesh torn and blood flying everywhere!

"Sling! Sling!"

The greenskin knights shouted orders loudly.

Some greenskins who could use slingshots to attack from a distance threw stones at the position of the hydralisks under the cover of their companions.

This kind of long-range attack was too primitive. It was okay to hit people, but it was just a tickle to use it against the Zerg.

The hydralisks launched two more waves of long-range attacks, and a large number of greenskins fell down immediately.

"Concentrate your strength! Charge out!"

The greenskin knight in charge of commanding the battle found that the long-range attack of the hydralisks was too terrifying. If they continued to hold on, they would be wiped out immediately. He immediately changed the order and ordered the greenskins to break through with all their strength.

"God of the Spirit! Give me strength!"

The remaining greenskins who could still move shouted the name of God, found a direction, and launched a desperate charge.

The puppies surrounded them and started a fierce melee with the greenskins.

The hydralisks stopped firing, and they each looked for targets and attacked the greenskins who gathered together.

The two Zerg arms cooperated with each other at long range and short range, and the greenskins soon fell on the way of charging.

In a short time, nearly three hundred greenskins were eliminated, and Wu Qing only lost a small number of puppies.

Anyone who plays the tactic of adding fuel to the fire with the Zerg is asking for trouble.

The greenskins suffered a great loss when the enemy situation was unknown.

The greenskin army outside the forest soon approached the forest.

"Master Priest, the situation in the forest seems to be very bad. Should we wait for the arrival of reinforcements before making plans?"

A knight next to the giant lizard suggested to the white-robed greenskins.

"The will of the spirit god cannot be disobeyed!"

The white-robed priest scolded expressionlessly.
